name: Ample Classes Are Not Closed Under Arbitrary Coordinate Fiber Products
statement: Allowing two or more shared coordinates destroys general closure: two maximum classes can have a nonample coordinate fiber product.
proof: On the same two shared coordinates, the maximum paths $\{00,10,11\}$ and $\{00,01,11\}$ have coordinate fiber product equal to their intersection $\{00,11\}$. That class shatters both singleton coordinates but contains no edge, so it is not ample.
